basic_info.description: Set above a tree-lined street and fully detached, 436 Joost is a light-filled urban retreat that offers warmth, scale, and serenity. The main level features an open floor plan with bay windows framing southern outlooks, a spacious living room with a fireplace, and a dedicated dining area. At the heart of the home is a remodeled kitchen with sleek finishes and updated appliances, designed for both daily living and entertaining. Upstairs are three large bedrooms and two full baths on the same level, including a generous primary suite with two closets and an ensuite bath. All bedrooms feature custom built-out closet systems. Sliding doors from both the primary bedroom and an additional bedroom open directly to a garden oasis and an expansive view deck. Both bathrooms have been tastefully remodeled with modern fixtures and clean design. A large garage with internal access and abundant storage offers flexibility and room to grow. Located in a quiet pocket of Sunnyside just minutes from Glen Park Village, BART, tech shuttles, and freeway access, this fully detached home combines rare privacy, natural light, and inviting outdoor space in a fantastic location.
